Downgrade pressure: (i) the 1-parameter core is standard branching-function/entropy-growth technique; (ii) the same mechanism appears in three sibling model papers of the same release, so this is a cluster-level device (one day after 074); (iii) the transport/descent step itself is elementary. Correctness of the whole package is unverified. Would fall to N2 if an expert identifies the 2-parameter extension as routine once canonical names are defined.

family_D.label: D3 (provisional)
family_D.rests_on: C1 alone: the 2-parameter entropy-excess potential with zero boundary trace and transport inequalities (P54+P68+P72; round P86+P88).
family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) an expert judges the 2-parameter extension routine given branching-function / entropy-growth methods; (b) Test 4 shows high hit rates in the directed arm; (c) the project decides that same-release sibling papers (074 one day earlier) count as model-produced precedent; or (d) the proof is found to have a gap in Secs 4-6/8 (then the device is unvalidated).
family_D.not_transfer: The ingredients (entropy calculus, Ren-Wang, GWZ, Bateman, Ramsey) are imported N0 tools; C1 is a new potential built from them, not an imported concept.
family_D.correctness_caveat: Entirely conditional on correctness of an unrefereed, unformalised 12.6k-line proof that would also settle Bochner-Riesz, sphere restriction and Kakeya maximal in R^3. Only Secs 0-2, 9-10 and the closing proofs were read line-by-line.
family_D.compression_note: Not measured. Qualitatively C1 is what lets the argument close at the critical exponent with no fixed loss; the cluster-wide reuse (074/077/078) is weak evidence for downstream speedup, but all uses come from the same model lineage.

P-C1.equivalence_criterion: A proposal hits if it defines a nonnegative information/entropy deficit function of at least two scale parameters (time depth and a resolution) that vanishes on a boundary where labels determine the record, and derives directional differential inequalities whose integration along a path contradicts nonnegativity. A 1-parameter entropy-growth contradiction alone (like P50) counts as a partial hit.

P-C2.equivalence_criterion: Proposal selects extremizers of the exponent with an additional minimised geometric cost and derives linear-in-depth benchmarks / affine width profiles.

P-C4.equivalence_criterion: Proposal reduces thin neighbourhoods of null hyperquadrics (or light-cone pieces) to a parabolic-cylinder model via a conformal/Lorentz map, keeping a 1-D quantum normal evolution below the uncertainty scale.

open_questions: Is the proof correct? Independent expert reading of Secs 4-6 and 8 (about 9,000 lines) is the precondition for any eureka claim.
Does the 2-parameter excess appear in sibling 074 in the same form? A line-level comparison of 074 Secs 30-70 with 079 Secs 4-6 would settle whether C1 is a 079-specific device or a cluster-wide one.

Does any human 2024-2026 work (e.g. Wang-Wu two-ends Furstenberg for restriction, Gan-Wu, Orponen-Shmerkin-Wang ABC) already contain a 2-parameter Lipschitz-profile potential with transport inequalities? Not found by the searches here; zbMATH and MathOverflow were not queried.

Downstream speedup: the same device reportedly closes 074, 077, 078. That is suggestive but not independent (same model lineage); a held-out test on, e.g., Kakeya in R^4 or restriction for hyperbolic paraboloids would be informative.
